Markets.title: Upstox begins talks with investment banks for $350-400 million IPO; crosses 2 crore customers
Markets.summary: Investment platform Upstox is in talks with banks to raise $350 million to $400 million through an initial public offering of new and existing shares. The proposed stock market listing comes as the company surpasses two crore customers.

Markets.title: Augmont Enterprises mops up Rs 246 crore in anchor round ahead of IPO; Nomura, HDFC MF among investors
Markets.summary: Augmont Enterprises raised Rs 246.3 crore from anchor investors like Nomura and HDFC Mutual Fund ahead of its IPO opening on August 21. The company plans to use the fresh issue proceeds for working capital and inventory before listing on the NSE and BSE on August 31.

Markets.title: Ahead of Market: 10 things that will decide stock market action on Friday
Markets.summary: Indian equities ended a seven-session losing streak, with the Sensex surging 628 points and the Nifty gaining 154 points. Analysts remain cautious due to elevated crude prices and ongoing geopolitical risks despite the improving market sentiment.

Markets.title: General Atlantic Singapore sells Rs 1,400 crore KFin Technologies stake; Invesco, Mirae Asset, HSBC MF among buyers
Markets.summary: General Atlantic Singapore Fund sold a 1.51 crore stake in KFin Technologies for approximately Rs 1,400 crore at Rs 925 per share. Several mutual funds, including Invesco, Mirae Asset, and HSBC, purchased the majority of these shares.

Markets.title: F&O trading bill: Retail traders pay Rs 25,000 crore transaction costs in FY26 despite big losses
Markets.summary: In fiscal year 2026, retail traders paid approximately Rs 25,000 crore in Futures and Options transaction costs. Meanwhile, about 88% of these traders suffered aggregate losses totaling Rs 91,685 crore, with options making up 92% of those losses.

Markets.title: Retail F&O boom hits reverse gear as active trader base falls 18% in FY26: Sebi
Markets.summary: The number of individual equity derivatives traders fell 18% to 8.8 million in fiscal year 2026, marking the first annual decline in over a decade. Despite this drop, 87.7% of traders still lost money, collectively dropping 91,685 crore rupees, with options accounting for 92% of those losses.

Geo-Political.title: Russia 'purposefully' hit critical infrastructure in latest strikes, Kyiv mayor says
Geo-Political.summary: Overnight Russian strikes on Kyiv killed at least 17 people and purposefully damaged critical infrastructure. Mayor Vitali Klitschko reported that the massive attack has disrupted the city's hot water supply.

Geo-Political.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
Geo-Political.summary: Following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire without a diplomatic resolution, Donald Trump has promised harsher economic measures against Iran and its supporters. This escalation occurs as the ongoing conflict lacks any clear military or diplomatic off-ramp.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: Hui Ka Yan, the founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande, has been sentenced to life in prison. His sentencing is a major development in the aftermath of the company's collapse, which heavily impacted China's real estate sector.

Geo-Political.title: Como mayor bans 'beasts' in city centre after being hit by bike
Geo-Political.summary: Following a collision with a cyclist last month, Como's mayor, Alessandro Rapinese, banned bicycles and similar vehicles from the historic city centre. He justified the restriction by referring to the rule-breaking riders as "beasts."

Geo-Political.title: Assad officer extradited to Syria on war crimes charges for first time
Geo-Political.summary: Lebanon has extradited former Syrian General Adel Issa to Syria to face war crimes charges. This marks the first time a former Assad regime officer has been handed over on such charges as Syria steps up its pursuit of wanted officials.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors are appealing Erin Patterson's prison sentence, arguing it is too lenient because it includes the possibility of parole. They stated she must stay in jail forever for her "truly dreadful" crimes.

Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. Whether the currency benefits depends on whether the central bank absorbs these inflows as reserves or allows them to enter the market.

Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires clearer evidence of persistent high inflation before acting. Consequently, the rate-setting panel signaled potential future policy tightening if price pressures continue.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from IHMCL reveals how high-volume corridors, changing private sector involvement, and the FASTag annual pass shape India's highway revenue. These factors determine who pays for and profits from the country's toll road infrastructure.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has raised India’s fiscal year 2027 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%. However, ongoing downside risks include the West Asia war, high headline inflation, a depreciating currency, and weaker-than-expected capital expenditure.

India.title: High Court Takes Note Of Meghalaya Violence, Orders Strong Action
India.summary: The Meghalaya High Court took notice of recent violence that damaged government, police, and public transport vehicles while endangering citizens and school children. The court ordered the state government to take strong action in response to the incidents.

India.title: Man Kills Specially Abled Person After Fight Over Seat, Then A "Crow" Defence
India.summary: A man killed a specially-abled person on Thursday afternoon following an argument over a seat on a Churchgate-Borivali local train. The attack occurred between the Mahim and Bandra stations.

India.title: 3 Khasi Students' Union Leaders Sent To Jail Over Shillong Violence
India.summary: Three leaders of the Khasi Students' Union were sent to jail following violence during a bike rally in Shillong. During the rally, statues of Swami Vivekananda and Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose were vandalised and several vehicles were torched.

India.title: Video: Bengaluru Rider Almost Run Over By Tanker After Bike Hits Pothole
India.summary: A Bengaluru motorcycle rider fell off his bike after hitting a pothole on the road. A following tanker then ran over the fallen motorcycle, narrowly missing the rider.

India.title: Speeding Aston Martin Rams, Kills Woman In Hyderabad, MP's Son Charged
India.summary: A speeding Aston Martin driven by Sanjush, the son of Lingamaneni Ramesh, struck and killed 26-year-old mall saleswoman Bharathi in Hyderabad. Sanjush has been charged with rash and high-speed driving following the fatal accident.

India.title: Congress-Ruled States To Challenge Mines Law In Top Court: Sources
India.summary: Chief Ministers and leaders from Congress-ruled states are planning to file a joint petition in the Supreme Court against the new mines law. Telangana Chief Minister Revanth Reddy, Karnataka's DK Shivakumar, and Kerala's VD Satheesan are leading this legal challenge.
